ui.about_mission_desc: At Break Out, we believe coffee is more than a drink — it's a moment. We craft each cup with intention, sourcing premium beans from around the world and roasting them to perfection in-house.
ui.about_vision_desc: To be Cairo's most beloved third place — not home, not work, but somewhere in between. A space where creativity flows, connections deepen, and routines are broken.
ui.menu_subtitle: Artisanal coffee, handcrafted frappes, Italian baking & gourmet desserts. Explore by category, search, or toggle to classic Spacca menu list.
ui.contact_subtitle: Enjoy our cozy atmosphere, premium coffee, and friendly community. We can't wait to serve you!
